canonical_project: Paratera Inner Mongolia Computing Base (并行科技内蒙古算力基地)
owner: Beijing Paratera Technology Co., Ltd. (北京并行科技股份有限公司)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). Total investment ~3.0B CNY => ~60 MW at 2MW/亿 conversion. Building a 60,000 PFLOPS smart-compute service platform with 10,000-GPU cluster (H800/A800/昇腾910) in Horinger New District; DeepSeek models deployed 2025-02. Capacity is investment-based; the reported 6万P target was not converted to MW to avoid overstatement.
